##### Project general facts

Reportage Residences at Lahore is an apartment development with pale façades, warm vertical accents and glazed balcony railings. Residential floors rise above a podium base, bringing private homes and shared leisure spaces together within a single building.

Shared facilities include an infinity pool, gymnasium and padel court, alongside a rooftop barbecue area and restaurant. Outdoor seating and a coffee corner provide spaces to gather, while laundry facilities, a prayer area, dedicated parking and electric vehicle charging support daily routines.

The homes offer one-bedroom and two-bedroom layouts, with open kitchens connected to living and dining areas and separate bedrooms. Private balconies or terraces vary by layout. Interior features include kitchen cabinets, built-in wardrobes, aluminum windows and tiled bathrooms with showers, vanity units and mirrors.

##### Parking

Shared parking.

##### Location description and benefits

Lahore combines established residential neighborhoods with a broad range of services for everyday life. Schools, universities and healthcare facilities support family routines, while local markets, shopping destinations, cafés and restaurants give residents a choice of places for daily errands, dining and social gatherings.

Shalimar Gardens and Model Town Park provide green spaces for walks and outdoor recreation. Alhamra’s galleries and performance venues broaden the leisure options with exhibitions, music and theatre, while Lahore Fort and the Walled City reflect the heritage that shapes the city’s cultural character.

Canal Road and Lahore Ring Road support movement across the city, while the wider highway network provides links to other parts of Pakistan. Lahore Metrobus and the Orange Line Metro Train offer public transport alternatives for daily journeys, and Allama Iqbal International Airport provides domestic and international air connections.
